android-feedback|Error state.summary: A Plenix error state on Android is a centered Column in the region that failed: the tone’s icon (danger, warning or success solid on the surface; the muted content color for the neutral kinds), a DM Sans title at the label role, the text at the secondary role in the subtle content color, and one outlined button that recovers or moves on. The kinds (offline, degraded, permission denied, not found, maintenance, completion) bring their icon, tone and words from string resources. The error tone is a live region so TalkBack reads it when it replaces the content; Material 3 has no error-state component, so Plenix composes it.

variants.name: Error
variants.compose: PlenixErrorState(Tone.Danger, "The assets could not load", "The server did not answer.") { OutlinedButton(onClick = retry) { Text("Retry") } }
variants.use: Content that failed to load, with Retry.

variants.name: Warning
variants.use: Something needs care before the region works fully.

variants.name: Permission denied
variants.use: A screen the person may not open.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.about: The kind’s icon in the tone’s solid color, or the muted content color for neutral kinds.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.about: What happened, in DM Sans at the label role.

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.about: Why, and what to do, at the secondary role.

anatomy.name: Action
anatomy.about: One outlined button: Retry, Try again, Go back.

attributes.value: feedbackDangerSolid, feedbackWarningSolid, feedbackSuccessSolid; neutral kinds in the muted content color
attributes.compose: Icon(kind.icon, contentDescription = null, tint = PlenixColors.feedbackDangerSolid.current(), modifier = Modifier.size(PlenixIcon.iconSizeLg))

attributes.value: DM Sans semibold at the label role in the default content color
attributes.compose: Text(title, color = PlenixColors.contentDefault.current(), fontFamily = PlenixFonts.SANS, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textLabelSize)
attributes.views: TextView with the DM Sans semibold font and textSize from textLabelSize

attributes.value: DM Sans at the secondary role in the subtle content color, centered
attributes.compose: Text(text, color = PlenixColors.contentSubtle.current(), fontFamily = PlenixFonts.SANS, fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textSecondarySize, textAlign = TextAlign.Center)
attributes.views: TextView with gravity center and textColor from contentSubtle

attributes.value: 8 dp between the parts, 4 dp more above the action (PlenixSpace.spaceStackSm, spaceStackXs)
attributes.views: LinearLayout vertical with gravity center and spacing from PlenixSpace.spaceStackSm

states.compose: Modifier.semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite } on the title
the region shows its CircularProgressIndicator while the attempt runs

compose: fun PlenixErrorState(tone: Tone, title: String, text: String, action: @Composable () -> Unit = {}) {
Icon(tone.icon, contentDescription = null, tint = tone.solid(), modifier = Modifier.size(PlenixIcon.iconSizeLg))
Text(title, color = PlenixColors.contentDefault.current(), fontFamily = PlenixFonts.SANS, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textLabelSize,
Text(text, color = PlenixColors.contentSubtle.current(), fontFamily = PlenixFonts.SANS, fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textSecondarySize, textAlign = TextAlign.Center)
